To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the schools that are affiliated to teacher training institutions, and are known as ‘lab schools’, ‘practice schools’, or ‘teaching schools’, are sites for research learning for student teachers; and, 2) these schools can also provide a rich research context for research into teacher education and the teaching and learning of teachers, if they are used as research spaces.
